Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.

  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing sub-award administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: The Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, but is expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless operations. In the absence of the Incoming team, the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, sub-awards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.

    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.

  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.

  • Operational Process Design – Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.
  • Data Analytics & Process Improvement – Ability to track, analyze, and optimize pre-award workflows and research funding success rates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication – Skilled in collaborating with faculty, administrators, legal, compliance, and external sponsors to facilitate research success.
  • Contract & Agreement Oversight – Ability to review and sign standard proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, with judgment to elevate complex cases appropriately.

Minimum Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de IA | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Nesta oportunidade você será responsável por liderar a evolução da nossa estratégia de IA no ecossistema de Data & Analytics. O foco principal será o desenvolvimento e a implementação de pipelines de IA ponta a ponta, automatizando a construção de modelos analíticos que impactem diretamente a eficiência operacional e a experiência do cliente em nosso Contact Center. Esperamos um profissional que não apenas domine a técnica, mas que tenha a capacidade de traduzir a complexidade tecnológica em Produtos de Dados e resultados tangíveis para o negócio, garantindo a qualidade, a escalabilidade e a manutenção de modelos em produção (perenes).

Temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem-vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar.

Para te ajudar a entender este desafio, aqui estão algumas responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e conduzir projetos de IA/ML do design à produção, garantindo o uso de melhores práticas de engenharia de software e monitoramento contínuo.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar soluções de processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) e IA Generativa (LLMs) voltadas para a análise de interações e automação de feedbacks.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de atendimento, compreendendo KPIs (TMO, ABS, Taxas de Conversão, Rechamadas, Transferências, CSAT) para desenhar soluções que gerem valor real.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Product Owners, Analistas de Negócio, Engenheiros de Dados e Especialistas de Operação, garantindo que a solução técnica esteja perfeitamente alinhada às necessidades de quem utiliza o produto na ponta.
  • Fomentar um ambiente de troca de conhecimento, participando ativamente de rituais de agilidade, revisões de código (code reviews) e construção conjunta de soluções, evitando silos técnicos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados e modelos dentro do ambiente Databricks, assegurando código limpo e escalável, documentado e versionado (Git).
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos para públicos não técnicos, defendendo pontos de vista e influenciando tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados.
  • Disseminar a cultura Data-Driven na organização e atuar como mentor para membros menos experientes do time, elevando a barra técnica da área.

Para esta oportunidade, é necessário que você:

  • Tenha experiência sólida com Python, SQL e Spark (Databricks).
  • Experiência comprovada em colocar modelos de ML em produção (Deployment e Monitoramento).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de ML (PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, XGBoost, etc)
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de IA Generativa, NLP (spaCy, NLTK, LangChain, etc)) e Prompt Engineering.
  • Tenha boas habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma hibrida no mínimo 1x a 2x na semana (Rio de Janeiro);

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Senior Kotlin Software Engineer

VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.

We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.

What you will do

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high‑quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.

What we expect from you

  • 5 years of experience in software engineering.
  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

Working schedule

  • Follows the Portugal time zone.

FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) Engineer

We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.

The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open‑source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat).
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel.
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD.
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.

Mandatory Skills Description

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas.
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals.
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture.
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems.

Nice‑to‑Have Skills Description

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code.
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.).

Intelligence Architect (Conquer AI)

Conquer AI is hiring an Intelligence Architect to help us design and deliver real‑world AI systems for enterprise clients in Brazil.

This is not a research‑only role, and it is not a strategy‑only role.

We are looking for a strong software engineer who can work directly with clients, run technical discovery, shape use cases, and then build the solution from POC through MVP and Phase 1 delivery.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong software engineering background.
  • Experience with RAG, LLMs, machine learning, and AI application development.
  • Strong hands‑on skills in Python and Node.js.
  • Ability to design, build, and deploy production‑ready systems.
  • Confident working directly with clients and cross‑functional stakeholders.
  • Able to move from problem definition to technical architecture to delivery.
  • Strong communication, ownership, and execution skills.

What you’ll do

  • Work closely with clients to uncover high‑value AI opportunities.
  • Lead discovery sessions and translate business problems into technical solutions.
  • Build POCs, MVPs, and early production systems.
  • Design workflows that combine retrieval, reasoning, automation, and human‑in‑the‑loop review.
  • Operate as a trusted technical lead across both client‑facing and delivery work.
  • Help ensure what gets built is usable, scalable, and grounded in real workflows.

This role is a fit for you if

  • You are a builder first.
  • You can speak to executives, operators, and engineers without losing the thread.
  • You enjoy solving messy workflow problems with elegant technical systems.
  • You want to work on high‑impact AI delivery, not internal experiments.

Senior React Native Mobile App Engineer

Expert level proficiency in React Native for building high‑performance reusable components for both iOS and Android.

Experience & Skills

  • State Management mastery of Redux, MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence.
  • Experience writing Native Bridges (Java/Kotlin for Android, Objective‑C/Swift for iOS) to access device‑specific features not covered by standard React Native APIs.
  • Deep expertise in optimizing app render times, memory usage and battery consumption.
  • Navigation proficiency with React Navigation or React Native Navigation for complex screen flows.
  • Expert use of Metro Bundler, Xcode and Android Studio for building debugging and profiling applications.
  • Experience managing the end‑to‑end release process for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store including TestFlight and Beta testing.
  • Code Push proficiency in using Microsoft CodePush for over‑the‑air OTA updates to bypass traditional store review cycles for critical hotfixes.

Secondary Technical Skills: Integration & DevOps

  • REST & GraphQL – Deep understanding of consuming complex APIs, handling authentication (OAuth2, JWT) and managing data synchronization.
  • Experience implementing offline capabilities using WatermelonDB, Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity.
  • CI/CD pipelines – Experience with Fastlane, Bitrise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines.
  • Testing – Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end‑to‑end (E2E) automation.
  • Monitoring – Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing.

Key Responsibilities: AMS Context

  • Mobile App Support – Lead the resolution of Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents affecting global mobile users from UI glitches to critical sync failures.
  • OS Compatibility – Proactively manage app updates to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS and Android versions and hardware releases.
  • Complex Change Requests – Translate requirements from Sales and Marketing leads into technical mobile features, design, develop and test enhancements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) – Perform deep‑dive analysis on app crashes, API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes.
  • SLA Stewardship – Ensure all mobile services meet strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for our 24/7 global field operations.
  • Technical Mentorship – Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for React Native in the India hub, providing guidance to junior developers and UI/UX designers.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with TypeScript for type‑safe React Native development.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori for mobile or SAP Mobile Services.
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth IoT integration for warehouse scanning applications.
  • Experience with mobile security best practices – biometrics, certificate pinning.

Senior Software Engineer – Remote from Brazil

We are looking for a kind, curious, and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems and building impactful user experiences.

This is a fully remote role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience, with strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentorship, and personal growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Write high‑quality, scalable, and testable code that drives key business initiatives.
  • Contribute hands‑on while also helping shape the technical direction of the team.
  • Build and maintain features using modern technologies such as:
  • Elixir, Ruby.

  • Participate in architecture and design decisions.
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback.
  • Collaborate closely with teammates through pair programming.
  • Deploy and monitor user‑facing features in production.
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies and patterns.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir or Ruby.
  • Hands‑on experience with React and its ecosystem (Node.js, npm).
  • Familiarity with:
  • RESTful APIs.
  • Git and version control workflows.
  • TypeScript.
  • Understanding of event‑driven architectures, databases, and GraphQL.
  • A problem‑solving mindset with a focus on user impact.
  • Interest in e‑commerce, retail, or building sustainable digital ecosystems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kafka (event streaming).
  • Experience transitioning from monoliths to microservices architectures.

Why Join Us

  • Work with a supportive and collaborative team that values growth.
  • Have real influence on technical decisions and product direction.
  • Be part of a mission‑driven environment focused on innovation and sustainability.
  • Continuous opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career development.

Senior Go Engineer – Realm FinTech

Realm is partnered with a high‑growth fintech building a payment fraud detection platform. The platform rapidly identifies and prevents fraudulent transactions, significantly reducing response times.

Who we’re looking for

A backend engineer with exceptional Go programming skills (min 2 years of commercial Go experience) and a strong foundation in databases, gRPC, and scalable system architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for chargeback management, integrating with credit card, banking, and merchant platforms.
  • Design and implement robust microservices architecture, leveraging reusable frameworks and libraries.
  • Optimize system performance and security by leading code improvement, CI/CD enhancement, and technology upgrades.
  • Drive platform innovation by identifying improvement areas and owning feature development from inception to deployment.
  • Lead complex projects; provide strong leadership and mentoring skills.
  • Communicate effectively and collaborate across teams.

Technical Stack

  • Go, DynamoDB, gRPC, Docker, SNS/Kafka (not exhaustive).

Experience

  • 6+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in Go production environments.
  • Proven experience in platform architecture and development.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
  • Excellent problem‑solving abilities and deep technical knowledge.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

  • Is a great listener, coach, and trusted advisor with the ability to understand client business context and support the sustainability transformation journey.

Job Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience working in a management consulting firm.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of relevant industry solutions and best practices in operational risk, operational excellence, and sustainability practice lines.
  • More than 4 years of experience in delivering growth and key services in transforming companies in the Power Industry.
  • Strong communication skills at the manager level, with the ability to effectively drive business development, solution development, and high‑quality delivery of key services.
  • Proven experience in managing, leading, and developing a team.
  • An entrepreneurial spirit, results‑focused, and adept at thriving in a fast‑paced, rapidly growing consulting environment.

Working Experience

  • Technical knowledge and experience in supporting clients on transformational journeys, including strategy development, operational roadmaps, integration into business units and functions, and support in implementation.
  • Strong understanding of and familiarity with dss+ methodologies would be a plus.
  • A proven track record in management consulting and individual business development success.
  • Knowledge and experience in the Power and Utilities Industry.

Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, or related fields.
  • The ideal candidate will have strong consulting experience.
  • More than 4 years of professional experience in management consulting.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a team‑working attitude to collaborate within fast‑paced, multi‑cultural, and multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Fluency in English; Spanish language will be a plus.

description:

Se você quer atuar como Especialista TI (Engenheiro de Automação e Dados Industriais (Foco em Integração OT/IT)) temos um novo desafio para você!

Sobre a Eneva

A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural doBrasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançandode maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em 2026, a companhiaatravessa um ciclo de crescimento impulsionado por novos projetosestruturantes, operações de O&M e iniciativas de expansão (CAPEX), o queexige excelência em logística, comércio exterior, compliance regulatório eeficiência operacional em operações de alta complexidade.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Automação e Dados Industriais para se juntar ao nosso time de Dados & IA. O profissional será peça-chave na integração estratégica entre as áreas de Tecnologia da Operação (OT) e Tecnologia da Informação (IT) na Eneva.

O objetivo principal desta função é projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis, gerenciar a implementação de ferramentas de dados industriais e disponibilizar dados estratégicos do chão de fábrica para o nosso ambiente analítico, gerando valor e insights para as operações, com foco especial nos processos de nossas usinas térmicas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Projetos de Automação: Liderar o projeto de centralização de telas do Centro de Operações Integradas (COI), coordenando as atividades com as equipes de automação de nossas diversas localidades.
  • Arquitetura e Integração: Colaborar com as equipes de TI e Automação para desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de integração, discutir a liberação de protocolos e firewalls, garantir a conectividade e gerenciar a disponibilização de servidores.
  • Mapeamento de Processos e Geração de Valor: Aplicar conhecimentos de engenharia de processos para mapear as rotinas e demandas das equipes de Operações e Engenharia, identificando oportunidades onde o uso de dados pode gerar maior eficiência e valor.
  • Plataforma de Dados Industriais: Atuar na implementação e sustentação da plataforma Cognite Data Fusion para contextualizar e enriquecer os dados industriais, facilitando o acesso e a análise.
  • Disponibilização de Dados: Ser a ponte entre o chão de fábrica e o ambiente analítico, garantindo que os dados corretos sejam capturados na origem e disponibilizados de forma estruturada para consumo das áreas de negócio e ciência de dados.
  • Estratégia OT/IT: Contribuir ativamente para a estratégia de integração entre OT e IT, promovendo o uso de tecnologias e arquiteturas que garantam escalabilidade, segurança e governança.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Formação em Engenharia de Automação, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada com a suíte PI System (AVEVA), incluindo desenvolvimento e arquitetura.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em protocolos de comunicação industrial (ex: OPC-UA, Modbus) e conceitos de rede e segurança para ambientes de automação.
  • Experiência em projetos que envolvam a integração entre sistemas de automação (OT) e sistemas corporativos (IT).
  • Capacidade de mapear processos de negócio e traduzir as necessidades das áreas operacionais em requisitos técnicos e de dados.

Desejável

  • Experiência com plataformas de dados industriais, especialmente Cognite Data Fusion.
  • Conhecimento da arquitetura de Tecnologia da Automação (TA) da Eneva ou de ambientes industriais complexos.
  • Vivência em processos de usinas termelétricas ou no setor de energia.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (GCP, Azure, AWS).
  • Habilidade de comunicação e negociação para interagir com múltiplos stakeholders, desde a operação local até a alta gestão de TI.

Local de Trabalho: Riode Janeiro – RJ.

description:
Sobre a SPDM/PAIS e o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia.

Informações adicionais

  • Santa Cruz - RJ.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula -onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.

  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .

Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão!

description:
Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior

Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior - Rio de Janeiro | JobLeads
Despegar Rio de Janeiro | BRL 80.000 - 120.000
Faz parte dos primeiros candidatos. Há 4 dias

Resumo

Esta é uma oportunidade única para ingressar em um dos motores comerciais mais dinâmicos do setor de travel tech na América Latina. Como Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior , você terá ownership real sobre uma carteira de hotéis e receptivos na região do Rio de Janeiro e Costa Verde (Paraty, Angra dos Reis, Trindade), atuando em uma das verticais de maior crescimento na Decolar. O papel exige um perfil consultivo e estratégico, com foco em rentabilização e gestão de carteira. Você será o trusted advisor dos hotéis sob sua responsabilidade, construindo relações de confiança e posicionando a Decolar como parte essencial da estratégia de crescimento dos parceiros.

Para se candidatar, é essencial demonstrar experiência relevante em travel ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo, bem como formação adequada e habilidades de análise de dados e relacionamento com parceiros.

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  • Construção de Relacionamento: Desenvolver relações de confiança com os hotéis e receptivos da sua carteira, entendendo profundamente seus negócios, desafios e objetivos.
  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Monitorar e otimizar disponibilidade, competitividade tarifária, conversão e saúde do relacionamento com os parceiros, independentemente do porte do hotel.
  • Negociação Comercial: Conduzir negociações contínuas de tarifas, inventário, promoções e mídia paga nas marcas Decolar, HotelDo, entre outras.
  • Análise de Dados e Diagnóstico: Utilizar ferramentas como Metabase, Power BI e Excel para identificar padrões, priorizar oportunidades e criar planos de ação baseados em dados.
  • Revisões de Performance: Realizar business reviews e visitas presenciais regulares com os parceiros, aterrissando em planos de ação concretos e prazos claros.
  • Recomendações Consultivas: Traduzir dados e insights de mercado em recomendações acionáveis para os hotéis, garantindo que os parceiros saibam o que fazer, quando e por quê.
  • Gestão de Pipeline: Trabalhar a carteira com disciplina de CRM (Hubspot), mantendo oportunidades mapeadas, status atualizado e follow-ups no prazo.
  • Representação no Trade Local: Participar de visitas, feiras regionais e eventos do setor, representando a Decolar e identificando novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Interface com Parceiros: Traduzir atualizações de produto, pricing e distribuição em ganhos concretos para os hotéis.

Para se candidatar, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência: 3 a 5 anos em travel (hotelaria, operadoras, receptivos, OTAs) ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Turismo, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Consultivo: Escuta ativa, postura estratégica e capacidade de ganhar confiança pela substância das recomendações.
  • Habilidade com Dados: Excel avançado, leitura fluente de dashboards (Metabase, Power BI) e curiosidade para entender os números em profundidade.
  • Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir conversas comerciais do zero.
  • Perfil de Owner: Proatividade, iniciativa e capacidade de fechar ciclos de trabalho sem necessidade de instruções constantes.
  • Ferramentas: Experiência com CRM (Hubspot), Google Workspace e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes na região do RJ e Costa Verde. É importante que tenha CNH ativa
  • Idiomas: Português nativo; inglês intermediário; espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Paixão por Travel: Interesse genuíno pelo setor de hospitalidade online e turismo.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado local (RJ e Costa Verde).

Local de Trabalho

Base no Rio de Janeiro, com visitas frequentes aos parceiros na região.

Se você é apaixonado por travel tech, tem perfil consultivo e busca um desafio estratégico em um ambiente dinâmico, essa é a sua oportunidade!

title: Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations.
  • Escalate ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament.
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team.
  • Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner.
  • Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements.
  • Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.

Senior OutSystems Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large‑scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands‑on, high‑impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom‑built solution.

This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.

What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

  • Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies
  • Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability
  • Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

  • Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies
  • Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database
  • Replace inefficient polling with event‑driven or conditional patterns
  • Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

  • Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues
  • Refactor exception handling and client‑side lifecycle violations
  • Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

  • Establish a true multi‑environment deployment pipeline
  • Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs
  • Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls
  • Ensure non‑production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

  • Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities
  • Remove unused or redundant components
  • Define governance for capacity‑impacting changes
  • Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

  • Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes
  • Map data entities into portable schemas
  • Capture business logic embedded within the platform
  • Identify core business logic vs platform‑generated components
  • Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building and maintaining enterprise‑scale OutSystems applications
  • Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API
  • Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements
  • Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures
  • Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing
  • Hands‑on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems
  • Strong problem‑solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations
  • Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows
  • Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling
  • Experience with license optimization and application object management
  • Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e‑signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership
  • Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions
  • Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations
  • Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users

This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high‑visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next‑generation platform.

title: Productivity Finance Specialist
description:
Role Overview

This role sits within the Global FPS Productivity team and focuses on sustainably improving project margins, recovering lost value and supporting better business decisions. It is a hands‑on finance role for someone who wants to combine strong financial discipline with operational understanding, working closely with project, commercial and functional teams to turn insight into action.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Productivity team, project teams and finance colleagues to support project margin reviews and margin improvement actions.
  • Analyse project financial performance to identify margin leakage, recovery opportunities, recurring loss patterns and improvement themes across the project lifecycle.
  • Link productivity initiatives to project financial outcomes, helping the business understand where actions are driving measurable improvement, where value is at risk, and where expected benefits are not yet visible.
  • Strengthen productivity governance by aligning baselines, assumptions, reporting logic, benefit tracking and reconciliation to project financials, helping create one clear and trusted view of performance.
  • Work with commercial, sourcing, engineering, manufacturing and project stakeholders to understand root causes and translate findings into practical actions.
  • Own and develop the FPS product costing tool, ensuring it provides reliable costing insight for decision‑making, while leading requirements, testing, adoption and transition planning for more modern costing solutions.
  • Support ad‑hoc analysis for senior leaders on margin performance, risk areas, recovery actions and emerging trends.
  • Use data, dashboards and digital tools to improve the speed, visibility and consistency of financial insight.

Qualifications

  • Strong finance foundation, with relevant experience in FP&A, project finance, commercial finance, operations finance or business partnering.
  • Comfortable moving beyond reporting into a more operational, problem‑solving role with direct business impact.
  • Strong analytical capability and ability to translate financial performance into clear business actions.
  • Confidence challenging data inconsistencies, aligning stakeholders around common definitions and improving trust in the numbers.
  • Ability to challenge constructively, influence non‑finance stakeholders and work effectively across functions.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence to engage with project, operational, commercial and finance leaders.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where processes, tools and visibility are still developing, while helping bring more structure and consistency over time.
  • Confidence using Excel and financial systems; exposure to Power BI or data visualisation would be useful.

Desired characteristics

  • Experience in project‑based, manufacturing, engineering, industrial or operational environments.
  • Experience supporting project financial reviews or structured margin analysis.
  • Exposure to productivity, cost‑out, value improvement or recovery programmes.
  • Experience reconciling multiple financial views or establishing common reporting standards across teams.
  • Experience working with performance dashboards or visual reporting tools.
  • Qualified or part‑qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or comparable finance experience with strong commercial credibility.
  • Interest in using data and digital tools to improve decision making and business visibility.
  • Curious, pragmatic and resilient approach, with a strong sense of ownership and a focus on measurable outcomes.

Working patterns

  • Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 4:00 pm – On‑site RETIC (Fundão/RJ).

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programmes.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Tailored financial programmes.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 28 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Colaborativamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

Esta posição é para Os Batutinhas, uma das marcas de escola do Inspired no Brasil. Somos uma escola com mais de 20 anos de história formando as nossas crianças para saírem preparadas para enfrentar os desafios do Ensino Fundamental, apaixonados por literatura e com prazer de investigar o mundo. Baseado na teoria construtivista, o trabalho d’Os Batutinhas é ancorado na visão de que a criança assume o lugar de protagonista no seu processo de aprendizagem, construindo conhecimentos sobre o mundo e sobre si mesma.

Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos alguém para ser nosso(a) Professor(a) Regente Português do infantil. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas (esta é uma vaga temporária de licença maternidade).

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas como Professor(a) Regente Português no infantil alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência com infantil.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;
  • Inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?

Partner with the best

title: Fleet Services Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Fleet Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation Tournament fleet and for any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of fleet services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, VVIP, FIFA Delegates, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing fleet performance, developing, and ensuring compliance of Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA/LFS departments for all fleet-related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the VIK vehicle provider (Hyundai/Kia), ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, service levels, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of VIK vehicles, ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of VIK vehicles post-tournament, including damage reporting, documentation, and reconciliation with the provider.
  • Act as the primary operational interface with vehicle and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met.
  • Manage all ancillary contracts and operational processes related to the fleet, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines.
  • Develop the fleet depot Concept of Operations (including the fleet design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Fleet Operations.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of Fleet Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.
  • Manages day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers.
  • Do the entire setup of the Fleet Tournament Management System (TMM).
  • Ensures all fleet staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities.
  • It’s also responsible, in coordination with the fleet service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials.
  • During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to VVIP vehicles and all arrival and departure transfers, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams.
  • Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of event transport and fleet services experience in international major events in at least three (3) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Event Controller
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time ever is being hosted in South America in Brazil. This is an opportunity to be part of the workforce that is creating an unforgettable experience.

Department: Finance
Location: Brazil

THE POSITION

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich and the Senior Event Controller, the Event Controller will support in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle. The role will provide finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implementation Phase
    • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organise hands‑on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
    • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Planning & Operational Phase
    • Support in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes, working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
    • Work closely with the FIFA27 Senior Event Controller to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
    • Assist in the presentation of the quarterly forecast exercise and recommend corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
    • Support the accrual process at year‑end, supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 Accounting teams and the various budget owners.
    • Assist the review of monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re‑allocation journals when required.
    • Support the preparation of monthly management reports, providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
    • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad‑hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and financial planning & analysis.
  • Experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi‑entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well‑developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritise workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Proactive, hands‑on approach to problem solving with a "can do" attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI, Word & PowerPoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a Eneva

A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em 2026, a companhia atravessa um ciclo de crescimento impulsionado por novos projetos estruturantes, operações de O&M e iniciativas de expansão (CAPEX), o que exige excelência em logística, comércio exterior, compliance regulatório e eficiência operacional em operações de alta complexidade.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um profissional responsável por executar processos relacionados à liberação fundiária e regularização fundiária, incluindo: mapeamento, negociação, conferência de peças técnicas (planta, memorial descritivo, tabela de coordenadas e laudos de avaliação), gerenciamento de contratadas, interação com órgãos públicos e proprietários de terra, pagamentos e controle orçamentário.

  • Apoiar a gerência na gestão dos processos e contratos fundiários da companhia.
  • Garantir a execução financeira dos contratos de arrendamento/locação e daqueles de aquisição de imóveis pela companhia, pela plataforma SAP.
  • Atuar na negociação e liberação fundiária das áreas necessárias aos novos empreendimentos da companhia.
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar processos de regularização de imóveis.

  • Contratar e gerenciar prestadores de serviços fundiários.
  • Interagir com stakeholders internos e externos - cartórios, órgãos públicos, proprietários e demais atingidos pelos projetos da companhia.
  • Apoiar na valoração do capex fundiário para novos projetos e M&A.

  • Performar suas atividades de acordo com as normas da empresa, de segurança, de saúde, de higiene e da segurança do trabalho.
  • Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente empresarial.

  • Direito Imobiliário: Entendimento de documentos legais relacionados a propriedades; Georreferenciamento e Topografia: Domínio em levantamentos topográficos e uso de equipamentos para medição.

title: Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados e IA - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Desafios estratégicos

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo.

Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece de oportunidade

  • Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia
  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA

O que nos move:

Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.

Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.

Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.

Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.

Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

The LatAm Wellness & Oral Health Lead will serve as the LatAm R&D’s strategic scientific expert for the Wellness & Oral Health categories. This Director‑level role is responsible for shaping and advancing the LatAm Wellness & Oral Health R&D pipeline, ensuring scientific rigor, compliance, and consumer‑centric innovation across priority brands and therapeutic areas. The role is essential in implementing an end‑to‑end category‑led strategy, serving as a vital link between the R&D category team and the OU. The role reports to the LatAm R&D Lead and will have dual accountability to OU and Category.

Role Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

  • Provide scientific and technical leadership for the Wellness and Oral Health categories within the LatAm OU, shaping and maintaining the innovation and claims roadmap.

Technical Expertise & Evidence Generation

  • Lead design and execution of clinical, laboratory, and claims‑supporting studies, serving as the expert on wellness and oral care science within the LatAm OU.

Regulatory & Compliance Support

  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations within the LatAm OU.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Engagement

  • Collaborate across R&D, Medical, Marketing, Insights, Commercial, Consumer Science, Packaging, and Supply Chain functions, fostering collaboration and engagement across diverse teams and geographies.
  • Lead key R&D projects within the LatAm OU, ensuring scientific integrity and delivery, while managing the execution of innovation projects for successful commercialization.
  • Provide leadership for local and global brand initiatives, serving as a critical link between the R&D category team and the LatAm OU.

Strategic Collaboration & Consumer Focus

  • Drive strategic alignment with LatAm OU innovation needs by promoting knowledge sharing and collaboration across departments and regions, utilizing scientific literature and competitive intelligence to inform innovation strategies.
  • Ensure consumer insights are integral to innovation processes, driving early‑stage development and prototype creation that align with consumer needs and technical understanding.

Agility and Process Improvement

  • Champion innovative practices and the elimination of non‑value‑added processes, enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of project delivery in alignment with strategic innovation goals.

Basic Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD, DDS/DMD, MS) in a relevant scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years’ experience in R&D within consumer health, oral care, or pharmaceutical fields.
  • Proven expertise in leading innovation and development projects within the consumer health industry, with a strong focus on formulation and process knowledge.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross‑functional teams and drive collaboration across R&D, Commercial, Consumer Insights, and Supply Chain functions.
  • Experience in successfully transitioning innovation projects from concept to commercialization, with a track record of delivering consumer‑relevant and scientifically differentiated products.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform comprehensive evaluations of internal and external data to inform strategic decision‑making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated agility and adaptability in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment, with a proven ability to champion innovative practices and process improvements.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills, with a creative and proactive approach to identifying and delivering innovation opportunities.
  • Ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships with external partners and suppliers, fostering an environment of knowledge sharing and strategic alignment.
  • A growth mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and development, staying informed of industry trends and competitive intelligence to drive strategic innovation.

Location – this role is based in: Brazil

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
Would you enjoy being the quality focal point for complex subsea projects, ensuring requirements are met from fabrication through delivery?

Would you like to act as the main interface between customers, suppliers and project teams within a global energy technology company?

Join our Quality Team!

At Baker Hughes, Quality is fundamental to our project execution success. Our Project Quality professionals ensure that customer requirements, regulatory standards and internal quality processes are fully integrated and consistently applied throughout the project lifecycle, both in-house and at supplier facilities.

Partner with the best!

As a Project Quality Engineer, you will report with a solid line to the Regional Quality Manager and a dotted line to the Product Line Quality Manager. You will be responsible for ensuring the effective application of the Baker Hughes Quality Management System (QMS) and customer requirements across the assigned project scope, acting as a key quality representative toward customers, execution teams and suppliers.

Responsibilities

Project Quality Planning & Execution

  • Implementing quality requirements into product specifications and ensuring compliance at fabrication and execution locations.
  • Establishing the Project Quality Plan, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and related quality documents to guide proper execution.
  • Leading the Go / No-Go process for fabrication start and facilitating pre-production meetings.
  • Ensuring adherence to Product Line directives for standard quality requirements at fabrication sites.

Audits, Inspections & Controls

  • Performing frequent product quality audits, inspections and quality walks to ensure project requirements are properly flown down.
  • Running quality meetings with internal and external stakeholders to cover all product and project quality aspects.
  • Supporting and collaborating in supplier quality records (Manufacturing Record Book – MRB) approval processes.
  • Implementing and monitoring Project Quality KPIs related to MRBs, non-conformances, and punch lists.

Customer & Stakeholder Interface

  • Acting as the primary point of contact for customers on all quality-related aspects of the project.
  • Interfacing with customer site representatives, second- and third-party inspectors during execution, including inspection notifications.
  • Collaborating with product delivery teams to identify, track and close punch-list items.

Problem Solving, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Auditing technical requirements and implementing controls to ensure compliance.
  • Ensuring project Lessons Learned are properly captured, addressed and communicated to Project Management and Product Delivery teams.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Mechanical, Production or Petroleum Engineering.
  • Have advanced proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across different countries and regions.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements related to the fabrication of subsea equipment, including XTs, Manifolds and Tooling.
  • Have experience supporting or conducting quality audits for customer project assessments.
  • Have strong fundamentals in product quality inspection, testing and documentation analysis.
  • Have solid experience interfacing directly with customers.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills with proven interpersonal effectiveness.
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams or initiatives of moderate scope and impact.
  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously with strong organizational discipline.
  • Effective problem identification and solution mindset with analytical rigor.
  • Knowledge and application experience with FMEA methodologies.

Working Patterns

  • 7am-4pm OR 8am-5pm, following manufacturing site activities.
  • Location: Macaé, RJ OR Curitiba, PR.

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programs.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Specialist – QA Engineering

What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. The Role

Reporting to the customer support and training Team-Lead, the Technical Support Engineer will be responsible for providing remote and/or onsite technical support and training activities for Aspentech SSE modeling products, including SKUA, RMS, and EPOS.

Your Impact

The role entails utilizing technical expertise and interpersonal skills to guide users in effectively onboarding to the software, ensuring a thorough understanding of its functionalities and workflows. The specialist will collaborate with users to optimize workflows, enhance project efficiency, and actively identify and pursue business opportunities within customer accounts to expand Aspentech Software's presence.

You will also work with our local IT and Sys Admin team to always maintain our systems operational and functional.

  • Provide loyalty-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
  • Support clients locally or remotely by helping them grow their knowledge of AspenTech software and workflows, while properly using internal procedures and systems for support, tracking, and reporting. Escalate complex issues to R&D when needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical and/or engineering-related problems reported by customers using AspenTech’s proprietary software.
  • Deliver high-quality training classes based on relevant geoscience principles and upstream workflows, and develop or maintain customer-focused training materials for new releases and industry applications.
  • Develop long-term relationships with assigned users by understanding their challenges and working closely with Account Management and Technical Sales teams to address them using AspenTech solutions.
  • Work within the AspenTech SSE interdisciplinary team on customer engagement activities, including preparing and summarizing technical proof of concepts, proposals, and recommendations.
  • Conduct pre-sales consultations to identify business problems, analyze client or prospect needs, and position AspenTech products as solutions. Proactively support sales efforts in collaboration with Account Managers and Technical Sales teams.
  • Maintain and expand knowledge of the scientific principles behind the software, as well as current technologies, workflows, support standards, and troubleshooting techniques, leveraging the company knowledge base.
  • Participate in customer projects, proof of concepts, and technical activities, as well as local industry events and tradeshows when required.
  • Perform additional activities such as conducting health checks on assigned accounts, delivering onsite support and consultancy, deploying AspenTech solutions in customer environments, contributing to departmental improvement projects, and authoring technical white papers for the company knowledge base.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Geology, Geophysics, Petroleum Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in a related field is preferred.
  • 5 years of relevant experience in Reservoir Modeling and characterization.
  • Solid geomodelling project execution track record.
  • Previous experience with Aspentech SSE Software for Modeling (SKUA/RMS) is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of reservoir engineering/ uncertainty analysis tools is a plus.
  • Proficient in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Knowledge of New or Renewable Energy workflows (like CCS, Geothermal Energy) is a plus.
  • Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.
  • Ability to travel. Travel is usually less than 30% and may occasionally be international.
